pr_body:
Test failure was caused by https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/102078

Closes: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/103357

review_comment:
This change is required to make test reproducible.

ShardRouting hashCode relies on AllocationId. In this case allocation is generated randomly at https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/e1c96c4837482649391d5714cdd686f3cd8086e3/test/framework/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/cluster/routing/TestShardRouting.java#L270-L276 
without test random source. This result in a different hash order of ShardRoutings in the set. 
Later in the test we rely on the test order when picking random shard with `randomFrom(shards)`.
Test never populated routing table. This condition was always true, safe to remove
